I wrote `component.html` in the finance folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It's a 1280px screen inside `#component`, with static HTML and CSS only. It has the "Invoices" heading, the "New Invoice" button, the All/Unpaid/Paid filters with All selected, and the five invoice rows exactly as you gave them.

I followed `DESIGN.md` and inlined the token values the page uses:
- **Header:** a full-width pale blue band holds the title and the one primary button. The content below it is 1120px wide and centered.
- **Table:** 16px text, 60px rows, and the Invoice column in bold. Amounts are right-aligned, blue and bold with fixed-width digits so the decimals line up. Due dates use fixed-width digits too.
- **Status pills:** Paid is filled blue. Unpaid and Overdue are outlined, because the design rules give both the same "needs attention" style.
- **Filters:** the selected "All" has a pale blue fill, since the rules allow only three button kinds.

"Dense" runs against the design rules, which set 16px text and 60px rows as a minimum, so the table is roomier than a spreadsheet. I followed the rules. If Finance wants it tighter, that needs a rule change first.

The Waikīkī fonts (Unbounded, Archivo) aren't in this folder, so the page falls back to the system sans-serif unless those fonts are installed.
